abstract: |
  This notebook presents a tutorial on confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) power analysis. We use a real database from the WHOQOL-Bref scale as an example (n = 1,546), and we demonstrate how to conduct CFA power analysis using various R packages. We also discuss the importance of power analysis in the design and interpretation of CFA studies.
